tools.name: get_ai_exposure
tools.description: Look up the AI Exposure Score (0-100) for a job title: its band (Low, Moderate, Elevated, High, Very High), percentile, example tasks that are automatable, augmentable or durable, and adjacent careers with their scores. Scores are precomputed estimates of how much of a role's tasks overlap with what

tools.name: search_occupations
tools.description: Find occupations whose titles match a search, with each one's AI Exposure Score, band and page URL. Use it when a job title is ambiguous, then call get_ai_exposure with the exact occupation.

tools.name: recent_ai_attributed_layoffs
tools.description: Recent layoffs where the company itself cited AI as a reason, from AI-Safe Careers' curated tracker, each with its date, approximate headcount and source. All-cause layoffs (layoffs.fyi, WARN notices) are tracked separately and are never included here, so these are not a count of all job cuts.
